DataLakeWebhook.//AuthMode: none | bearer | apikey | basic | hmac | oauth2. 'none' accepts any caller - fine for a loopback demo. The other three must match the auth mode configured on the FHIRBridge Data Lake Webhook destination.
DataLakeWebhook.//Secret: The bearer token, API key, or HMAC shared secret. Required unless AuthMode is 'none'.
DataLakeWebhook.//HeaderName: Which header carries the key when AuthMode is 'apikey'.
DataLakeWebhook.//StoreMode: both | raw | properties. 'raw' stores only the verbatim JSON, 'properties' only the flattened key/value rows.
DataLakeWebhook.//OAuth2: Used only when AuthMode is 'oauth2'. POST /api/datalake/token issues tokens for these credentials, and the receiver then accepts only tokens it issued. DataLakeWebhook:Secret is ignored for this mode.

OAuth2.//TokenLifetimeSeconds: Keep it short to watch FHIRBridge re-acquire a token; its own cache honours this value.
